summary: Tested enquiry popup auto-show functionality and critical bug fix for form fillability. The CRITICAL BUG (unable to fill form inputs) has been FIXED - all text inputs are now fully fillable without the popup closing. However, a new issue was discovered: Select dropdowns (Project/Requirement) cause the popup to close when clicked.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking Select dropdowns (enquiry-project-select, enquiry-requirement-select) causes the popup to close immediately. The Radix UI Select Portal renders dropdown content outside the modal, and when the SelectTrigger is clicked, it triggers the popup to close. This prevents users from selecting project/requirement options.
integration_issues.suggested_fix: The Select component needs special handling in the modal context. Options: (1) Use modal={false} prop on Radix Select if available, (2) Replace shadcn Select with a custom dropdown that doesn't use portals, (3) Add event handling to prevent popup close when Select is interacting, (4) Increase Select portal z-index further and add onOpenChange handler to prevent modal close

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL BUG FIX SUCCESSFUL: Form text inputs are now fully fillable without popup closing. NEW ISSUE: Select dropdowns (Project of Interest, Requirement) cause popup to close on click. This needs to be fixed by either: (1) configuring Radix Select to work in modal context, (2) replacing with a non-portal-based select component, or (3) adding special event handling to prevent modal close during select interactions. The z-index of SelectContent was increased to z-[250] but the issue persists, suggesting it's an event handling problem rather than a z-index issue.

success_percentage.frontend: 75% (6 of 8 features working - text inputs fixed, selects broken)
